name: Versioned save migration
summary: Persistent progress survives software change when save schemas declare versions, migrate through explicit steps, validate before commit, and fail without overwriting the last readable state.
player_action: The player launches a newer build, changes platform, resumes offline, or resolves a synchronized-save conflict.
system_response: The game identifies the save lineage, migrates a copy through known versions, validates earned state, and atomically promotes or visibly rejects the result.
failure_modes: Migration loses, duplicates, or reclassifies earned state.
A newer unknown save is accepted as an older schema.
Cloud conflict selection is hidden from the player.
A crash leaves neither original nor migrated state readable.
accessibility: Conflict and failure prompts must be readable through supported text, narration, and input configurations.
Accessibility settings require the same explicit version and migration policy as progression state.

smallest_playable_test.setup: Create saves at every supported version and profile state, then inject interruption at each migration boundary plus newer, corrupt, duplicated, offline, and cloud-conflict cases.
smallest_playable_test.retain_if: Every supported source reaches one validated successor without loss or duplication and every unsupported source leaves its parent intact.
smallest_playable_test.revise_if: State is preserved but the conflict or recovery path is unclear to players.
smallest_playable_test.reject_if: Any interruption or version produces silent acceptance, partial migration, overwrite, loss, or duplication.

evidence.claim: Epic documents GUID-based custom versions so independently evolving systems can identify serialized data versions.
evidence.notes: Supports explicit version identity; atomic migration and rollback remain release requirements here.

evidence.claim: Bungie documents one active Destiny 2 character set across linked platforms, dormant non-selected characters, platform-license boundaries, authentication, and deactivation consequences.
evidence.notes: Demonstrates why account, character, entitlement, and platform identities cannot be silently merged.
